title: Apollo 11 complete model review
brief: Airbus Apollo 11 research model, revision c545dbffebc4d20f61bd29262f459ec9d0c301a8. All 28 original SysML files are retained. This scaffold contains illustrative and incomplete research assumptions; it is not approved Apollo design or verification evidence.
questions: Review mission-system composition, Saturn V stages, CSM interface, five first-stage engines, and mission transitions. Distinguish aggregate collections from component occurrences. Declared satisfaction and transitions do not establish physical verification, execution or acceptance.
